messages:
Marisol (CSE): Heads-up — ZenFlow just turned on ChatOps for their FieldOps BU (~120 active seats). They're seeing sustained long-context sessions and hit a few 429s/timeouts in the last 2 hours. They asked about rate limits, predictable billing, and dedicated capacity options. cc @Liam @Tara

Liam (Eng): Thanks Marisol — can you paste an example request payload and the model they used? avg token lengths?

Marisol (CSE): model: redwood-chat-medium-2025; typical prompt ~2.2k tokens, responses ~700–900 tokens. They send ~6 reqs/sec per seat during peak; overall tenant qps ~720. Latency spiked to 300–600ms, and we saw 3x 429/timeouts in a rolling 30m window. They also asked whether seat-based pricing or committed capacity would be more cost-predictable.

Tara (CS Ops): Noted. This looks like KV-cache pressure + longer seq lengths. On hosted we can tweak batching/prefix caching limits, but for consistent behavior recommend Dedicated pool. @Noah can we enable tenant-level longer KV retention and a canary route?

Noah (Eng-runtime): We can. On hosted tiers we cap KV retention for multi-tenant fairness. For ZenFlow we can: 1) enable longer KV retention, 2) pin them to a smaller set of nodes, 3) adjust batching window. But for true predictability (and to hit their SLA ask) we'd need Dedicated or Private. I'll open infra ticket.

Marisol (CSE): AE already offered a 7-day Dedicated trial to the customer to validate performance & cost predictability. Renewal is due in ~6 weeks; they're flagging billing predictability as a potential risk. They also need SSO and SOC2 answers before renewal.

Liam (Eng): Can you paste the problematic request or a sanitized session id? Would help repro. Also, for immediate relief we can lower concurrency limits per seat as a temporary throttle to avoid 429 storms.

Marisol (CSE): Example payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-medium-2025",
  "messages": ["system: assist field agent","user: long transcript... ~2k tokens"],
  "max_tokens": 1200
}
```
They reported missing per-message metadata in logs too — wants better attribution per agent.

Noah (Eng-runtime): Created infra ticket INF-8921 for KV retention + canary route. PR for batching tweaks in flight, ETA: tomorrow EOD for the initial canary. Will add a config flag to pin the tenant to the pool.

Tara (CS Ops): I'll schedule an enablement session with FieldOps ops team (this Wed). Marisol, please confirm primary contacts.

Marisol (CSE): Contacts: jules@zenflow.com (FieldOps PM), rita@zenflow.com (Ops lead). Also capturing feedback: they want per-agent attribution in audit logs and a clearer per-seat cost estimator.

Pamela (Product): Noted on the per-agent audit logs — we can add message-level attribution in 2.3.1 backlog. Marisol, can you collect a repro session id and the exact fields they expect?

Marisol (CSE): Will collect and upload logs to the ticket.

Sanjay (AE): I'll prep a renewal playbook and pricing scenarios for seat-based vs committed Dedicated pool. If they opt into the 7-day trial, prioritize a cost model with amortized GPU hours and projected token spend.

Liam (Eng): Quick config suggestion for the trial (no guarantees, canary only):
```yaml
tenant: zenflow-fieldops
kv_retention: extended
batch_window_ms: 15
max_concurrency_per_seat: 8
pinned_pool: dedicated-trial-2x
```

Noah (Eng-runtime): Will apply canary config after INF-8921 changes merge. I'll post the canary link and perf dashboard.

Marisol (CSE): Thanks — I'll run the enablement and collect trial metrics (latency, errors, cost delta). AE: Sanjay — will loop you in once trial starts.

Sanjay (AE): Perfect. If trial metrics show >30% reduction in tail errors and predictable cost within their threshold, I'll push to convert to reserved Dedicated. If not, they may evaluate self-hosted options. Documenting renewal risk now.

deploy-bot: Dedicated trial pool `dedicated-trial-2x` allocated for tenant zenflow-fieldops (expires in 7 days).

Marisol (CSE): Follow-up plan: 1) enable canary today, 2) Wed enablement session, 3) 7-day trial metrics posted in this thread, 4) renewal playbook updated. Assign owners: Noah -> infra/canary, Tara -> enablement, Sanjay -> renewal/pricing, Pamela -> product follow-up. I'll post trial kickoff time in #customer-success once confirmed. :thumbsup:
